description: Duval County Emergency Management Portal is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by Neetesh Sharma, Florida State University (fsu.edu). This project develops a web-based Geographic Information System (GIS) decision-support tool for Duval County, Florida, to assess how flood-induced transportation infrastructure disruption affects accessibility to critical emergency services. Conducted under the direction of Dr. Neetesh Sharma, with Dr. Eren Erman Ozguven and Dr. Coverage: Duval County, Florida (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-t7d9-sp10. Keywords: flood, emergency service accessibility, GIS, transportation network vulnerability, flood resilience, road network disruption. Published 2026-09-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
